messages.desktop.guide_text:
1. Refresh and select a game window.
2. Choose a profile and mode.
3. Start. Processed images open in a separate preview.

X11 and Windows GDI paths exist. Windows was not run on this machine. Native Wayland, GPU exclusive fullscreen and protected content are unsupported.

Repetition creates no new motion. Interpolation waits for a second image. 3x/4x requires more computation. A black capture may indicate API incompatibility.

Scaling affects the preview only, not the game resolution or FPS.
